comments: Before the third track, Tommy Vance thanks Richard Skinner for "jumping in at very short notice" to host the previous week's show because Tommy had lost his voice.
Staff Selection of tracks (Men At Work and Little Feat) chosen by Tommy Vance (because of the deceptively simple guitar solo) and Tony Wilson.

sessions.details: Repeat broadcast of session recorded 3rd December 1982. John Hall (guitar/vox), Andy Skuse (bass), Chris Logan (drums). First broadcast 14 January 1983.
Archive session tracks recorded 27th January 1970 for Top Gear.
